In Re. Cran 4 of 2026
1.
This is an application for joint compromise filed on behalf of both the parties who are being the sister-in-law as well as the defacto complainant.
The opposite party no.2 being one of the applicants herein is present through virtual platform and she is represented by the learned counsel.
State is also represented.

2. It is submitted before this Court by both the learned counsels that memorandum of settlement under Section 89 of the Code of Civil Procedure and the Rules 24 and 25 Karnataka Civil Procedure(Mediation) Rules, 2005 was entered into between the parties before the Additional Principal Family Court at Bangluru in MC No. 4679 of 2021.

entities.text: Additional Principal Family Court at Bangluru
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: In the said memorandum settlement, it was agreed by both parties not to proceed with the pending proceeding and also agreed in view of settlement arrived, they would cooperate each other in the disposal of the petitions both for quashing of the proceedings.
In the said agreement, the list of proceeding pending includes the present criminal revision being CRR 1424 of 2021.

1 3.

In view of this development and as the said memorandum of settlement has been arrived and the joint compromise petition has been filed by virtue of the order of the learned Family Court dated March 4, 2026, where it was ordered that such mediation agreement dated February 25, 2026 to be part and partial of the degree, this Court of view that there is no impediment to allow the prayer of the petitioner.
4. Hence, this revisional application is disposed being settled between the parties.

5. Accordingly, the proceeding pending before the Court of Judicial Magistrate Malda being the G.R.
Case no.5451 of 2020 under Section 498A of IPC read with Sections 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act is hereby quashed.
6. Accordingly, CRAN 4 of 2026 is disposed of.
7. All parties shall act on the server copies of this order duly downloaded from the official website of this Court.
(CHAITALI CHATTERJEE (DAS), J.)
